name: print-social-poster-set-y2k-techno-time-floral-cutout
title: Magenta/navy Y2K 'Techno Time' poster set with floral photo cutouts
whatItIs: Four bold magenta-bordered vertical posters mixing navy grid panels, orange/purple photo-cutout flowers, and a large vertical 'TECHNO TIME' sidebar headline repeated across the set.
whatItMeans: Cutting real flower photography against flat graphic panels bridges organic and digital aesthetics, embodying the 'techno' theme through contrast rather than literal tech imagery.
techniques: run a bold headline vertically along one edge as a repeating structural sidebar across a poster series
juxtapose real photographic cutouts against flat grid/color panels for organic-vs-digital contrast
use a thick solid-color border to unify visually varied interior panels within one series

vocabulary.definition: a photographic element isolated from its background and placed directly into a flat graphic composition
